title: IndiaAI Compute Capacity
summary: The IndiaAI Compute Capacity pillar gives startups, MSMEs, academia, researchers and government bodies subsidised access to GPUs through empanelled cloud providers. MeitY's IndiaAI division issued a request for empanelment on 16 August 2024; ten bidders qualified and their prices were opened in January 2025, and the compute portal launched on 6 March 2025. The original target was 10,000 GPUs. The government reported 38,000 GPUs onboarded by late 2025 at a subsidised rate of about ₹65 per hour, and announced 20,000 more in February 2026. The IndiaAI site lists individual allocations, including 4,096 H100 GPUs to Sarvam AI.
beneficiaries: Startups, MSMEs, academia, researchers and government entities
